text: This is basically our family's favorite breakfast stop. The staff is great, the food is always great. I've never had an empty cup of coffee!!

This is a nice little find for sure. I have passed by the Seabreeze many times, and there always seems to be several cars in the parking lot. 

 Family owned restaurant, with a steady flow of regulars. The wait staff is friendly and prompt, and there is a great selection on the menu.  There are several specials that change daily; the sign out front advertised $1.50 Bud Light drafts... have to come back for that one. 

I had the Polish Omelet, with home fries and wheat toast. All cooked to order, hot and fresh, for about $8. Breakfast was delicious, and they were very prompt with coffee refills. 

A nice find and will visit again

I stopped here with a friend after visiting the track. We ordered a rib tip dinner and small tips. It was plenty of food. The mild sauce is really sweet. Next time I'd ask for a mix of the two. The potato salad and Mac and cheese were awful. Sadly the tips were very chewy. I feel they were a bit overdone. My friend did not like them at all. The service was incredibly friendly so I'm willing to give them another shot. May try the sandwiches.

I rarely right reviews but for Sofia I had to. I ordered the citrus salad with shrimp and it may be one of the best tasting things I have ever had. Seriously! The combination of flavors and freshness were truly amazing. I also had the risotto verde that was really good and a perfect follow up to the salad. 
The service was fantastic and I really liked the interesting video window and projections.
I look forward to coming back.

I am SO glad this place opened. Everything I've gotten has been excellent and perfect. Cheese on the bottom round pie, tomato pie with fresh mozz, Tommy hoagie,  veggie hoagie, tuna hoagie (it's chunky tuna- not super mayo heavy tuna salad), even a hot veggie grinder which isn't on the menu but they made it when we asked. This place really is south philly in the suburbs. 

The tomato pie is hot- it's not at all like Corropolese style- but it's so good and I wouldn't necessary compare them to each other because they're very different. The sauce is homemade marinara- nothing wild or crazy, just good old fashioned tomato sauce. It's not sweet. The crust isn't NY style thin, but it's def not as thick as most tomato pies. It definitely leans towards being actual pizza rather than tomato pie but it's SO good. My favorite pizza in the suburbs right now.
Liked it when it first opend. Food isn't as great or tasty as it once was. Happy hour is fair, drinks are yummy however food slightly lacks
Joe's Peking Duck is the best I ever had! The duck is perfectly prepared and the side orders are very tasty, every time I fly into Philly,  Joe's is my favorite dinner restaurant!

The best dining experience I've ever had. the service was extremely impressive, our waiter Billy went above and beyond! It was my birthday and there was a birthday card, he had classy little decorations for the table, gave me a rose and  their famous banana foster creme  brûlée on the house truly trimpressed by him! The food of course was amazing too. Everything on the happy hour menu was delicious and so were the entrees. The bread was even amazing ! Highly recommend the Brussels sprout side, lollipop lamb chops, calamari, and salt and pepper shrimp. My parents got the big Eddie seafood tower which was delicious and the banana foster  creme brûlée was delicious.

This please is awful. Go to MJ's or Nudy's if you want a real breakfast/ diner experience. Literally everything seems like it was made in the microwave, and nothing they have stands out. Good maybe if you are starving and it's the only place open. Other than that, avoid like the plague.
This place is a real find.   Lovely cafe with lovely cafe selections.  So nice to find a local place in touristy St Petes.

I parked on a side that made it a little confusing entering, so I entered where it said exit...oh well...anyway, the ribs were excellent!!!! Very very tender, got the spicy bbq sauce on the side...got it to go, ordered the half rack of ribs, comes with a piece of Texas toast and all the utensils you could need...good stuff!!!

Food was amazing and delicious! The girls at Coffee Grounds told us to try it out. Scallops were so yummy! Our server James was very professional! We went during Early Dinning, and restaurant was filling up throughout our time there. Great service and delicious food.

Well, what can I say?  Colder morning running errands make me want some hot & spicy desayunos!  I was on the S end of Reno and wanted my favorite, chilaquiles!
Lucky for me, I let Yelp lead me to The Lunch Box, a cute little dinerette on the corners of Longley & McCarran.  The outside patio looks like fun in the warmer months, but today's temps had me inside and ordering to-go.
Their chilaquiles was pretty good, I'd say, and it hit the spot for breakfast on the go. You can choose eggs or meat, and it came with dry toast that I used to dip that runny egg yolk with, yum!  It had a slightly greyish/reddish hue, however, and had good spice but lacked something...cheese!  I nearly ruined the entire plate for myself after being cautioned on their habanero salsa, and out of bravado and love of heat, poured a ton on!  My fault, not theirs!  Pro tip: stick with their red sauce if you don't want to have to put a fire out.  I literally raced to Trader Joe's for yogurt, that's how hot that salsa was.  You've been warned.
The portion was decent and the price was great, $7 bucks with tax and it included a drink, too! 
Nice, friendly folks at the counter and kitchen, they seem cozy like family and I totally dig that.  Add good food at great prices, and I'll surely come back again!
Made the mistake of ordering a bacon bomb burger, it was inedible. Not sure if the bacon jam was bad or if it was just the burger seasoning but I took 1 bite and left it on their counter.

I expected this to be good from reviews but I am blown away. The pies were all so good; the cafe buys them from a traditional Aussie bakery started in Sydney and now in ATL, GA. They take 20 mins to heat so call ahead if you're in a rush! We tried 4 of them and our fav was the Steak and Cheese. The drinks were delicious- way better than my beloved starbucks/dunks. We sat outside with our dog and they brought out a bowl of water for him. It's the little things. Can't wait to stop in again soon.
This was an outstanding place - service was excellent and the food was even better - we were there to celebrate  my son's upcoming wedding.

Went here on Christmas Eve, and the food and service was very good.  The flavors were perfectly balanced and the service was on par making sure we were satisfied with everything.  I will come back again for sure.  Glad I found this great place close by.  Thank you.

Somedays this place is amazing and sometimes it's not. So that's why the four stars and not five. Last time I was in I got all of my food at the same time, I got my salad when I got my main dish. The BBQ is a little expensive for the portion size you get, but it's very good meat. The brisket is supposed to be prime beef. The service is inconsistent, but good food and nice drink selections.

Ordered takeout last night and had quite an experience! When I got there to pick up my delicious pizza I could tell things were very busy. There was a wait for pick up. They also seemed to just be starting up with distanced dining in. We had a bit of a mix up with the vegan pizza I'd ordered. I got home with a very non vegan pie instead, but I cannot believe the lengths Stormy and her daughter went through to make it right. I called and Stormy answered, "I'm so glad you called! We have your pizza here! We're gonna bring it to you!" And they did. They were slammed, in the middle of navigating a larger than expected amount of quarantine takeout orders and in house customers. This after everything else they've gone through as business owners during a pandemic. They brought me my vegan pie. I already LOVED their pizza, this made me glad they chose Nashville to build their business. Great food and even better people. I wish I could hug y'all! You are doing it! Keep up the hard work and kind hearts! :)

We ordered the edamame, carpaccio, and tiger roll. It was a very busy night and we expected a wait for all of our food!! That was not the problem. We got the carpaccio and edamame after like 15 minutes but it took about 30 more minutes for the small tiger roll. We tried explaining to our server that we wanted to enjoy our meal together and she said that it takes extra time for the small tiger roll because of the shrimp tempura. The table next to us ordered at the same time and were served 6 rolls before we received all of our food. If that's all we ordered, we would have appreciated being told there would be a 30 minute extra for 1 roll. Both the server and the older woman that came to our table both laughed it off and barely apologized- like we should have known that it was going to happen. Just would have wanted a heads up.
Delicious banana French toast. Awesome turkey club with avocado.  Small space so come early and get  ready to eat delicious food.

We stopped here on Friday and we disappointed that they were closing (in 30 mins). They would let us order. Told us to come back Saturday they would be open until 12am. Not the case. Due to COVID they close at 9pm. 

Any way we got there at 5:30pm. I Ordered the gluten free Alfredo.  Alfredo was heavy on garlic, Wow delicious. My family order the pizza and crabs. They loved it. I wish I was able to eat more because they did have a gluten free pizza. The pizza was amazing According to the family worth the $15 for a small 10in (personal size). Maybe next visit I will do the pizza.  

The portions are small. Prices are high. Food is amazing.

What can I say, this place never disappoints! The atmosphere always makes us feel like we're on vacation, the food is beyond delicious, and the waitstaff is so friendly. (Make sure to bring cash, it's a cash only establishment.)
Although the food tasted good, I order the brisket lean. More than half of the portion was fat.

Popped in here for a quick and inexpensive breakfast. I opted for the scrambler: scrambled eggs, bacon, tater tots, cheese, and tomatoes in a cup for $4. It took about 10 minutes so it's not the ideal place to grab breakfast when you get off the train and you're on your way to work. The place is in Suburban Station and I found it to be a little grimey - sticky floors, crumbs on counters, etc. The staff however was kind and attentive to customers.

The scrambler was just alright. It was oily and I regretted not asking for salt and pepper because it lacked flavor. The bacon was well cooked and not the soggy kind you can expect from Dunkin. I wouldn't come back here for breakfast. I've had a grilled cheese from here which was solid so it's a 3-star spot.

This location never disappoints. They have the best service, best food, & best ambience. It's affordable for a family too! I came here for lunch two times! They have really good French Onion Soup too.

I am from New England and we know our lobsters and let me tell you the know how to cook them.  We started either lobster nibbler which turned us on to it lobster rolls.   And we also had shrimp basket which the shrimp were cooked to perfection

Went to Newks for lunch today. Their service was horrible. It was 40 minutes from the time we ordered until the time we got our food. We probably would have not had it in 40 minutes had we not asked about it. They are more worried about getting their carry out orders taken cars of than done in customers. We asked to speak to a manager and never saw one.

I absolutely love this place. The menu is huge so I can take clients multiple times a week and not get tired of it. The managing partner is not only there shaking hands and making sure people are happy, I've seen him take out trash and clean tables among other things. I'll he staff here treat me like family which you do not find at many places. 

They are big supporters of the community as well. I can't wait for these guys to re-open.

Honest restaurant is not being honest!! First time here.. The Punjabi Thali has aloo paratha on it and we ordered two meals.. It comes with naan. I asked him about it and he says the picture is not correct and that he can't do anything about it and that I should have asked him about it! This is even more worse.

Used to love this location! While they have a few great long-time servers, and some good new ones, the kitchen was very understaffed. No biscuits made, out of roast beef for lunch, lots of mix ups in orders due to kitchen
We got here just when they closed. However, they still took our order.  Definitely recommend this place.  The Italian icee was amazing.
First time trying this place. Our burgers were amazing. And the funnel cake fires were to die for.

Got a breakfast burrito and huge ice coffee Carmel and French vanilla $5 never had their breakfast wasn't disappointed 
My new fav

COVID breeding ground. Upon walking in, either the staff had on NO face mask or had them pulled down below their noses. As soon as they were away from a table, masks were off. 

I am completely angry and do not recommend this location.

So I was looking for a vegan place to get something sweet and found this local spot. It was hard to find the place when we arrived so when we parked I called and the man told us where to go. When we walked up there were a few people standing around in the restaurant, not really social distancing. It was uniquely decorated. I wanted the milkshake and wasn't sure if it was vegan becauseof the sign. I had to wait quite a while to even ask the server.  While waiting a man came in with a pitbull like it was nothing. I freaked out because I don't do dogs and why was a dog allowed in a restaurant where people eat? The owner of the dog had the nerve to catch an attitude because I freaked out.

When I finally got to the counter after waiting a while I asked about the milkshake and asked if it was 100% vegan like it was listed and yet again I got a a smart response from the man with the short dreads behind the counter.  I was not pleased with the service so I left.

Good food. Good drinks. Good service. Comfortable. 
It made for a good day date. 
I don't play golf but it looks like it would be fun so I'm going to try next time we go. 
Excellent wine choices. 
Menu is a little strange bc the app sampler has apps that aren't anywhere on the menu.
Yummy!! I recommend to everyone visiting the hill. Very fine dinning at a reasonable price!

This place is a hidden gem. The lasagna resembles the sought after garfield appearance- major positive. Highly recommend the calamari, they would make a grown man cry. The marinara sauce is out of this world.

On this day, uncharacteristically, my spouse said around lunch time that she wanted a hamburger. I had eaten at Kuma's Corner without her once, but only once, so I suggested going there. We were presented with a bewildering number of choices in regular burgers and a fewer number of their luncheon burgers. Normally, one gets fries with one's burger, but there is the ability to substitute a side salad for a $3.00 upcharge. And the difference between a regular burger and a luncheon burger is about 5 oz pre-cooked weight. The regular burgers are 10 oz and the lunch size is 5.5 oz. Since our appetites really cannot handle a 10 oz hamburger, our choices were easy. We each got a reasonably basic cheeseburger and a side salad. Well, you could have knocked us over with the side salad alone. It was surprisingly large and made of very fresh lettuce, cucumbers, onions, carrots, tomatoes and an absolutely lovely dressing. When our hamburgers arrived, they were cooked to the specification we had provided our server (medium) and they were juicy and delicious. We had asked for tomato and lettuce on top and that, too, was nice and fresh. And there was either a homemade catsup or tomato sauce on the side which also was delicious. There was an array of local beers both on tap and in the can. I opted for a Taxman Gold Standard, a canned Belgian style ale. All the way through we were helped by our very attentive server, a large African-American whose name we do not know. He was helpful both in se

We've been here a total of five times and each time I am more underwhelmed.  The wait time is extremely ridiculous even if you do call ahead. This is largely because of poor service from the wait staff and inefficient kitchen that causes longer than needed seat time for the eating customers.  So you wait long to sit then also wait long to eat once seated.  The menu is an interesting blend of healthy/ organic and "home cooked"...leaving food tasteless.   There's a rushed feeling when eating and food for table arrives at varied times and incomplete orders. I had much higher hopes from great reviews in other states.  Hope that feedback is considered because it has huge potential.

Been feeling under the weather lately. I feel bad that I'm a hawaii girl in Nashville. I can't just get my sushi fix down the street. But I come here for the meats and sushi! I love it! It's my second trip here with my husband, and we love it! It's only once in a while though. They were busy tonight. 20 minute wait for 2 people. 

Update review ------ 2019 Mar 28

We ordered food... waiter offered to put our take out in a container. Even though I offered to do it myself. I'm quite the control freak when it comes to neatness in the kitchen and food. 

First container that he brought out was too small. 

He got a second container out, barely any bigger, he spilled ALL of our food on the napkin and on the table. Picked up my rice from the napkin and put it into my container. 

I paid for service. Paid for my food. And this is how he wastes it. Bah humbug.

Ex-pat New Yorkers rejoice this is the real deal. Sabrett's franks boiled, not grilled (unless you ask and then she'll do it). Authentic N.Y. soft pretzels, too, although much too big for me. Only thing missing on the menu Chocolate Egg Cream!

One Star off because the Dogs are expensive.

It had good reviews, so we went...but my whole table was not happy with their order. Everything was blah! We were expecting great fish tacos and they were just not good! The coleslaw sucked! The French fries were meh! :( After that we skipped dessert and left. I don't want to be harsh but it's the truth. Sorry!

If I could give it more than 5 stars I would!!!!!   I just met Max and I am not 100% happy.   He should be open 24/7 and I would be back for breakfast in the morning.   Aaahhh, I can dream can't I!    In all honesty I had an extremely tasty dinner tonight.  I had the Swiss and Mushroom Burger that so many people in Yelp spoke about.  I had a side of Fries and my wife had the Tuna Salad Sandwich.   My wife and I enjoyed every morsel of food and I can promise you that if you go here you will too.   NOW GO AND GET SOME TASTY AND DELICIOUS FOOD!!!!!!   Max is waiting!   You won't be sorry!!!!!

A quality little place with welcoming employees. Located in a shopping plaza it was surprisingly delicious. They offer pasta at a great price and it is made to order. I ordered a second portion of their Alfredo with blackened chicken before I left. I would recommend to anyone in the area.

I will never order food from here again. I ordered quite a bit of food, including tabbouleh. When I arrived  to pick up my order I noticed from a menu pics that describes it served over iceberg lettuce. I told the man working that if it's served over iceberg lettuce I don't want it. He first told me to scoop it off. Next, he told me to be smarter about what I order. I told him that I've enjoyed tabbouleh from 4 other restaurants in Indy and they don't serve it on lettuce. Next, he told me he'd take it off the order and eat it for dinner so it did not go to waste.

Me and my wife celebrate our anniversary there the food was fantastic and the service was just as good and Jake Garrett I think he's a manager did a great job making our evening special.We have found our new favorite place to eat now.

Mafia movies have always made me hungry.  It's no coincidence that I crave meatballs whenever I watch one.  Really, I'd pay a lot of money to try Peter Clemenza's meatballs that he cooks in "The Godfather." Since I can't, I am at least fortunate that an Indianapolis restaurant specializes in this Italian-American mainstay. That place is Mimi Blue Meatballs, and it is a place that you'll surely want to try.

Mimi Blue has two Indianapolis locations - and one for the Carmelites north of the city.  Despite not living close to the Fashion Mall location, it was the easiest one at which to acquire a reservation.  Located in the mall, it's a classy (yet comfortable) dining experience. The service is very much on point, and the interesting and very friendly hostess was wearing a Rolex. Would you expect anything less at Keystone at the Crossing?

As its name suggests, Mimi Blue is all about meatballs.  While they do serve meatless balls for those who suffer from self-inflicted vegetarianism, I shan't focus on that in this review.  Being an apex predator, I'm interested in eating meat - and meat I ate. While your nona only made meatballs with beef and pork, old Mimi makes hers with that, too, but also with fried chicken, turkey, and regular beef.

Since meatballs aren't terribly large, the diner is easily able to select multiple different kinds and in many combinations.  Whether you want a plain meatball, alone or over a side of pasta - or a meatball on a slider smothered in one of the

Never had a bad meal in over 20 years of going here! Pizza is terrific (more of a sweet sauce rather than spicy) and they have solid sandwiches / wraps. Place is always clean. Reasonable prices. If only they delivered.

On my trip to NO I ate at several different places and had some great food but Oceana grill was on another level. I started with a bowl of chicken and sausage gumbo which was hands down the best gumbo in the French quarter. We then had a gator Po Boy and ordered it BLACK AND GOLD- 50% fried and 50% blackened and 100% freaking amazing. We also had a tasty mint julep and a local ale draft. The service was outstanding, thank you Amethyst! We just simply had a great time. Book ahead of time and get right in. Trust me on this one yelpers,  I don't play when it comes to food!

Another great meal in one of the prettiest outdoor spaces in Montco. Food here is always excellent, served fresh and hot. That said, the experience of getting to the table, despite a reservation, seemed a bit like Keystone Cops. Several very young folks at the hostess stand, but one seemed more confused than the other. Lot's of whispering and checking and more whispering and walking away - and returning to the desk... We asked about the delay and the response from one young man was unintelligible - something about a party of twenty... Finally a young lady asked us to follow her. She led us to two available tables and walked away...  When our very lovely waitress asked us if we were ready to order, we noted that we didn't have any menus. She told us we were supposed to have scanned the icon at the hostess desk so the menu would be on our phones. How would we have known that? Considering the amount of time we spent waiting there, someone might have mentioned that. We love this place, but customer service, and particularly communication skills, need some inservice training. Manager/owner was very present - eyes on everything, but he seemed frustrated by his own employees tripping over one another... It's got to be very tough to run a restaurant today.

Solid place for your typical simple slice! $4 for a very very large slice of cheese. We got one that was fresh from the oven so the cheese was really nice and droopy. The sauce is really tomato-y, so it's a little sweeter than i'd prefer.
Their food isn't the best quality honestly. I've ordered breakfast here several times and didn't eat all my food because it tasted bad. I do love their pancakes though! But that's about it

The place was a pigsty. Flies everywhere, the cooking area AND cook looked filthy and the men's bathroom smelled like a rancid porta-potty.

Apparently, the person who was to clean the bathroom was called away, because they left the cleaning supply caddy IN the filthy sink. I literally had to hold my breath while trying not to touch anything.

Don't let the outside stop you from coming in. Coming from a city like Chicago, I've had some of the best Mexican food and I can say this little gem didn't disappoint! Our server was super friendly and helpful. The establishment is spotless and the food was amazing. My boys had pozole and steak tacos. I had a burrito with pastor as the meat. Their chips and salsa were the best I've had in Indy! My favorite was the red one! We'll be back soon!

Good quality, fairly priced and nice first experience (takeout).  During the lockout, my family and I were craving sushi and wanted to try a new place. This was close by and we were really happy and satisfied. This might be our new Sushi/Japanese spot going forward.

Great food, excellent service! Very friendly staff, especially Donna! I had the baked Ziti, it was different of what I'm used to but good! Their chicken parm is delicious and so is their soups. I also had their fried calamari with their marinara but I'm partial to the garlic aioli sauce for this appetizer. Great experience overall, will come back to try their pizza!

Top reviewed brunch spot- thats what Yelp said and I was curious to try my 1st ever brunch in Indiana. First off, they do not accept advance reservations which was fine by me since it's a Saturday and I could afford to spend the extra time with my family. 
Parking isn't an issue and though wait times are long, sufficient space for social distancing. 20 mins we were called in, loved the open ambience, loud music, traditional look. Ordered drip and pour over coffee - honestly could be better. 
Latke for starters - hash browns with vanilla bean apple butter. The sweet and sour combo was divine, felt a variety of flavors in my mouth and was absolutely crispy and well combined.
Grilled cheese with duck egg - the duck egg was wow and half cooked to perfection. The cranberry walnut bread added a sweet and nutty flavor to the cheese.
Reuben Bialy - the CROWD STEALER! salmon pastrami cured to perfection! Combined with swiss pimento cheese! Absolutely delicious! Highly recommend.
Last but not the least - buckwheat cookie had such nutty flavor with strawberry deliciousness. Sweet for me but would be right for many.
Overall, high recommend. Both for value of money as well as great food and ambience.

I ordered a catfish poboy, not good at all. The bread was stale and the fish wasn't good either. Service was subpar at best. I actually give this place a two star however my Daughter filet was pretty darn good. Oh, I also ordered half dz charbroiled oysters, they were gritty and therefore not good eating. Definitely wouldn't recommend!

The Boba Tea was delish with heaping servings of Tapioca Pearls. The seating was plentiful and I had my choice of where I'd like to sit. I ordered Beef Pho and it came with a plate of goodies to add to my soup. I didn't quite care for the meat in the Pho, but I could easily pick that out. As it got later, it got busier and for good reason. The place is welcoming and bright and everyone that works there is beyond polite and friendly. The parking was a breeze and easy!

Please do not waste your time eating here.. I am not a picky eater at all and I can honestly say the food was NASTY. I ordered Italian meatballs, which were cold, overdone and tasted nothing like meatballs. My husband ordered burger and fries - fries looked and tasted like they had been cooked in really old grease, ew! The salad was ok but how can you mess up salad? Really disappointed as we were trying to support the new restaurant in our neighborhood but we will not be back. They really should close, what I experienced was unacceptable.

I love Chipotle, a little too much to be honest. I now live one minute from this location, and have continuously been disappointed. I know that with COVID-19 going on things are different, so I don't hold the slow pace against them, as I'm sure they're busy with online orders and are adapting. However,  I have rarely been greeted nicely there, and employees have had negative and seemingly rude attitudes. On top of that, the food has been poor. I have been told they are out of steak and that waiting for more is not an option, and the last two times I've gone there has been no cilantro in the rice. Lastly, last time I was there, there was two employees shouting at each other in front of everyone. One was by the kitchen, the other was at the grill.

Every-time I come to Nola this is always a stop.  The first time I came I stumbled upon it since it's near one of my favorite bars.  I love love their roast beef Poboy.  I do not eat this at home but it's soooo huge and juicy (and very messy) but totally amazing. It's now a tradition for me and I will be there this week. 
One thing is this place can get busy and you can wait a while so be prepared.  One of my favorites in NOLA hands down.

We ordered to go (via UberEats). Our driver had to wait for our order for nearly an hour. Our order was seemingly simple: a salad, cheese sticks with ranch, and a lumberjack burger with BBQ sauce. When the order was received there was no cutlery, no ranch, and the burger was a dry meat patty with bacon and a slice of cheese. When I called the restaurant to see what they could do, a very rude woman immediately told me it was Uber's fault and I need to contact them. She then promptly hung up on me. This was not the fault of the UberEats driver. The restaurant couldn't follow simple instructions and failed to offer any remedy when notified of the issues. The food was mediocre, and that's a stretch. To receive an order of mediocre food that was somehow screwed up and then have to deal with a woman with an attitude problem and the customer service skills of a feral dog was almost enough to ruin our evening.

haven't been to diner in ages.....! was looking forward to having a burger & fries.
what a disappointment! 
burger & fries came fast.....looked @ burger....was greasy!  i asked for extra onions..they gave me 1 slice. when i asked waitress for more onions(like i asked for) she went to owner to tell him! when bill came......they charged me $2.50 for an extra slice of onions!! and they charged my friend $.50 for mayo......
seriously....i could have bought a bag of onions for $2.50!
2 people....burger & fries with a cup of soup & a soda........................... 
$24.00 without tip!!!!!really!!!
got home & thanks to the expensive lunch...was sick as a dog!
never ever will i go there!
next time.....wawa.....hot dog & soda...$4bucks & my stomach doesn't get sick!

I called in an order at noon and picked up two bowls for my coworker and I. We work right around the corner and we're excited to have an acai spot so close. This was my second experience, was underwhelmed by the first but today was enough to keep me from coming back. Both our bowls we're completely freezer burnt!! It was so hard to eat and not what an acai /pitaya bowl should be. If I'm spending that amount of money on something it should be fresh. This tasted like it was in the freezer for days. And I was in the middle of work so could not go back for a refund. Definitely will be going to Frutta bowls instead. For such a high quality product it should be treated as such. Also not a big fan of their granola, but that's personal preference.

This location did a pretty ok job on our last two visits. The burgers were good . However, the first gist burgers were over cooked and the second time under cooked. The first visit the waitress was fantastic very attentive the second waitress wasn't nearly as good. We would ask for refills on french fries or drinks and she would completely forget. However, taking both visits into account they get 3 stars. I love the frickle lemonade and camp fire sauce.
Hands down one of the tastiest king cakes! I always ship one to my family in Florida for carnival season and they always arrive fresh and tasty!!

We fell upon this place by the help of the hotel staff when we were in training in Horsham.  The place is small but the food is OUTSTANDING.  Everything we had as part of the meal was delicious.  Each of us had the daily special which was pumpkin ravioli in a pink sauce with shrimp and scallops.  The food was plentiful which didn't allow us to enjoy a dessert.  While we were eating, all the entrees being served to other guests looked delicious and plentiful.  We will definitely be returning with some of our neighbors.
$17 and the deep dish was raw in the middle.. gross avoid!!! Had to just eat around the outside hope we don't get sick...

My first visit was yesterday during their grand opening and 6 different milk teas which were all pretty yummy. Today I went back for a large order for my boss and coworkers to try the popcorn chicken and Takoyakis. Also grabbed myself a Taro Milk Tea w/Mango Jelly. They were all soooo delicious!! I hope they're location is on the app soon so I can order ahead. Since they're so brand new of course they were busy and hopefully will stay that way. Staff is friendly and accommodating, excellent service, prices are beyond reasonable and so far everything I've had is really good. So happy I work down the street bc I definitely want to go back and try the Rice Balls and Crepes

First time here and it lived up to all the rave reviews I have been hearing.  Beautiful open space, well designed eating areas(both indoor and out). We were seated right away and our server was very friendly and attentive.  The GM came around and introduced herself and gave us a very tasty sea bass dish on the house.  All in all, it was the best sushi I've ever had!!!!

This location is going down hill fast. The last few times here it seemed disorganized and not very clean. We did a mobile order tonight. I ordered the food at 630 and the food was supposed to be ready at 7. I arrived at 658. Two people were waiting on mobile orders. It was complete disorganized and chaotic. 4 more people can in for mobile orders. No orders were ready. While I'm waiting for my food that was supposed to be ready at 7 they prepared an order that was supposed to be picked up at 715! I finally got my order at 715. It would have been faster just going through the line. 
Chipotle don't offer a service that you can't deliver on. This is my last time at this location.

This used to be one of my all time favorite restaurants. Ever since the Corp restructuring they have cut so many corners. I've given the benefit of the doubt for the last time. Tonight's visit alone (no kidding) hair in my olive oil for dipping, gnat in my water. The chicken literally had the texture of rubber. I sent it  back - got spaghetti Bolognese - how can you screw this up? The meat tasted so old. Like the sauce was made on Monday and I was having it for Saturday's dinner. I'm done!

Food is always good. 
Service is what you'd expect, lacking. It's not the cheapest, which is surprising for a bowl of rice noodle soup and the norristown location. But it's consistent. They win bc they are the only ones around.
Pizzeria Tivoli has fantastic food and a great patio! I definitely recommend this restaurant!!
This is an amazing place! The pizza, calzones, garlic knots and Philly cheesesteaks are amazing. They give you a lot of food for the price! My go to take out place for sure

Not bad I had the hula bowl. It was tasty they have several sauces to add and I tried three of them. Should have stuck to the one recommended for the dish. If u in to poke it's worth a try.  Quick and efficient take out even if u just show up and order.

This is what I wanted while vacationing in Philly and it did not disappoint.  I actually enjoyed Carmen's Philly Sandwich over Dinics Roast Pork sandwich.  It had way more flavor and at $10 bucks, great meal at a good price.  They were very friendly.  You can choose your cheese and any two toppings. They have other sandwiches but this is Philly, why eat any other sandwich.

Had amazing take out last night! We got the house salad, a Caesar salad and the lasagna. Everything was perfect! Hands down my favorite Caesar and lasagna I've had around. Next time I'll take pictures definitely going back!

Incapable of completing an order. Something is always missing. I've given them more than one chance, because I wanted to assume they just had a bad day, but it's happened multiple times, and they no longer have my business.

Updating to 5 stars now that I've tried every sandwich on the menu except the Phoagie. I come here about once a week, so a 4-star review would be disingenuous.

Seriously, just skip the Shopsin Club (what earned the original 4-star review). Every other sandwich is bomb. 

My personal favorites are the Baller and the So Long Sal. I can't say enough about how perfect these sandwiches are--probably the best I've ever had. Yeah, they're a tad on the pricier side, but they're totally worth the price. The flavors just pair perfectly together and the bread is heavenly.
Great food and fantastic service !! Nick was our waiter several of the times we were there. You would never imagine how good it is from first appearance of building.

Omg the Spicy chicken sandwich on a pretzel bun is to die for! I also tried the cheesy garlic bread sticks amazing! I love this place the food is awesome every time I order. Check out their weekend special it's a great deal.

I had the Ricotta & Goat Cheese Gnocchi. It was my first time trying Gnocchi. It was absolutely delectable. My hubs enjoyed the Beef & Butter Noodles. The Poison Apple cocktail is to die for. Be careful they sneak up on you.  Perfect Valentine's dinner date.

Bar food wings and such. Service is good girls are nice. When I went all there were was men hanging out and sitting at the bar. Finally an hour or so later a few couples came in with kids. The wings were ok I had the garlic Parmesan which didn't taste much of garlic.  I also had the fried pickles. 

The service was good. I think I was there at the perfect time it wasn't to busy. 

When I was leaving 4:30 it became crowded. 

Bar food tastes good and comes out hot.

Beautiful interior with varied menu from sushi to inspired Asian cuisine and an expansive cocktail and wine menu. Service was prompt and patient when we took a while to review the large menu. Our appetizer was dynamite shrimp which was very good though nothing special either. The walnuts were roasted and glazed and add a needed crunch to the fried and glazed shrimp. The tempura fried fish tacos were also good but the accompanying sauce was bland and not really well paired with the dish and much of the fresh items such as the guacamole and pico looked not fresh like it had been prepared earlier in the day and the avocados had turned and the others had wilted or with the slaw had begun to become runny. Would definitely give Wild Ginger another try for lunch or drinks but for the dishes we had they seemed over priced.

Had lunch here today.  Service was good. The lady was very nice and friendly.  Ordered sashimi lunch special and shrimp tempura lunch special. Portion size on both orders are surprising a lot larger than imagined, which is great compare to other sushi place around the area.  Both meals are very delicious!  Will come back again!  Happy to have this place nearby.

My guy and I stopped in because we took a one tank trip to New Port Richey and we needed a nice place to eat. I'd eaten here once before, and knew it was good food.  

Today, we opted to sit on the porch, since it was a lovely autumn afternoon and it was the perfect weather to be out doors. The patio is covered and has lots of vines that protect you from people, but you can still see the street if you're interested. 

We sat ourselves, but let the waitress knew we were there. She let us know she had a couple of people ahead of us, and we were cool with that, another girl came out and took our drink orders in the mean time.  When she finally came out, our waitress was extremely pleasant and friendly, she wore her mask the whole time. (Yes, they're still masked, which is awesome, they expect you to wear your mask on the inside as well.)

We placed our orders, I got their Chicken Quesidilla with black beans and rice, with homemade pico de gallo and my beau got steak and eggs. The food was fantastic, he ate everything on his plate, I couldn't finish mine, but It was really good.  I certainly recommend them if you're in town. Parking is right across the street and is free.

Absolutely love East Park Donuts & Coffee! The donuts are delicious (not overly sweet like some other hot spots in Nashville), worth every penny! We recently tried their breakfast sandwich on a house-made biscuit and did not disappoint. We are officially hooked!

Last but not least, the customer service is outstanding. The front of house manager is super cool, friendly and fast! We love the coffee there and will be recommending this place to all our friends and family!

well.. if ur gonna get breakfast somewhere might as well make it special :) it's been awhile since going out and first thought was french pastries... And who does baked goods better than one of our local favorite spots... bree'osh. Stopped by to grab an almond croissant and chocolate milk... Delicious. Always good and fresh. Fresh OJ option too!
Thank you for the delicious delicacies!

Stay safe everyone during this pandemic!
These people do not know how to take orders right three people went back because they were given the wrong orders I was given the wrong order like come on get your shit together

We came from SF. We were looking for something to eat and the owner was out side and invited or large party in. We asked for recommendations and he was right, every single thing I ate here was amazing. Love this place. Best meal I have had in Reno. Prices are amazing. This place is amazing!!!!

I've gone to this location since it's opened years ago, I used to work at the salon upstairs and went almost daily. It used to be amazing with the best customer service but it's definitely gone down the drain. There was no line and it took 10 minutes to even be acknowledged (5 employees walked by us including both managers). I had to take my takeout order back 3x for it to be right. I'm glad I checked it each time before I left. Then the girls at the food counter told my grandmother to wait up front for our smoothie (so she did)  Meanwhile the manager was asking where "Vicky's (me) order was", so I said "I'm Vicky, is it a strawberry banana a smoothie?" The mgr responded rudely "no, not you, there's a lady named Vicky up front" I responded explaining that that is my grandmother asking for vicky's order and that I am vicky,  that is my order. The mgr rudely reaponds "here" and banged the smoothie down on the counter....... This location needs to get it together.

Dont often hand out 5 stars, but this place wholeheartedly deserves it. 
Lunch while at Clearwater beach, was awesome and spicy as we like it. Had chicken biriyani, fantastic. Also chilli bullet naan, goat curry, karahi chicken and kadai mattar paneer. This is very good food and if aroma could kill we would be, each of these dishes had their own and fragrance
Definitely a come back again place.

It had been a long day on the lake, the last day of a family reunion, and we were driving back to Reno to our timeshare. We decided we wanted Chinese, so, to the trusty Yelp app I went. 

China Kitchen was right off I-80 in Northwest Reno, but it wasn't visible from the highway, so we were glad we had Yelp.

It's in a mini strip mall, maybe four shops total. You walk in and there is a cooler one your left work bottles of water, soda and juices. The counter is straight ahead to order, but if you're eating there you can take a seat. The menu is under glass on the table.

It's standard Chinese fare, the prices are very reasonable and there is a dinner and lunch special for about nine dollars. 

The staff was very nice, friendly and helpful. We asked for a special order item and they accommodated us without an issue. 

In our party we ordered pot stickers, sweet and sour chicken, General Tsao Chicken and sesame beef. Everything was cooked very well, good flavors. I'm not often in Reno, but when I am next I'll come back.

I ordered the supreme pizza online. I picked it up and took it home. The pizza was completely nasty! The attached photo of a slice shows the undercooked mess I was sold. The restaurant was dead so there was no reason to undercook the pizza.

Never again!!
Not only is the food great but the lady that owns the place, and dose the cooking is a real nice person and her daughter is a nice kid to.

I just left the Dog and Bull with my wife, we were greeted by a young lady and ask us if we had a reservation or walk in ? I said we are a walk in so she sat us down . The waitress came over and ask us if we want something to drink my wife said she will have a coors light and I will have a coke . She brought us 2 classes of water and took our order. 20 minutes later I got a Pepsi and 33 minutes later my wife got a bottle of Coors light  no glass or mug . We were listening to a young lady singing and the singer did 4 sets no salad for my wife yet. Then we got our food after we were done the side salad came out what a joke!!! Our waitress NEVER ask us or anything or if we need anything! She need people skills and customer service classes!!!

This place is everything and more. The atmosphere is very comfortable, however the establishment itself is very small I think it would be better if they had a bigger place. We entered through the back and while walking up to the front, it was very narrow and there's really no direction on where to go to start your order. Thankfully not that many people were there so we were able to walk around and figure it out. 

Once we ordered, the employees were very nice about everything and explained everything to us from beginning to end. I read some past reviews where people said that the staff were not so nice, my experience was very opposite. 

The food was absolutely amazing. I was in heaven. I couldn't believe what I just ate. I traveled the whole way from Harrisburg to try this place and it was well worth it. I'm very pleased with my order I would love to go again. The crust was thin the way I like it. It was cooked perfectly. 

I will certainly be back again. Hopefully it's sometime soon. I would eat here everyday for a week lol.

Ok, so it turns out that our nonstop running server managed to get it done. Then when the food finally made it out it was actually very good. So, yes, this place has lots of problems but I must be fair and say that it all came together albeit slowly.

Not impressed at all with their pizza. It seems to focused on gimmicks - eating contest, 30" pizzas, large gumball machines...  The product was just not very good. We had Pizza, meatballs and wings and was not wowed by any of them. It was ladies night, so after you paid for your food, you had to go to the bar and wait 5 mins for someone to serve you, then pay separate instead of being able to order and pay once. Stand in line for food and pay, then stand in line for bar drinks and pay. Not to mention being charged incorrectly and having to question it and have the charge fixed. The tea is bag in a box and not brewed tea, which is gross if you drink tea, but they have a nice wine list.

Petos is absolutely wonderful!!! You have to visit! The owners are so kind and attentive. The chef, Nermine, is extremely passionate about her food and it comes through in the presentation and most importantly the taste. This was my first time here as well as another group behind me and we all agreed that we need to come back. I got the special that the owners recommended and it was very good. I normally don't like chicken but this chicken was moist and very well seasoned. I would order it again. I also got a Greek salad that was amazing. Big pieces of feta and lots of vegetables. I didnt see any lettuce  which was great because I'd rather have other vegetables. I also got the dolmades and ! I finished the meal off with house made tiramisu, Turkish coffee and tea. I definitely took a lot home for left overs. I can't wait to come back! Thank you Petos family!

We did a pick up order that I had called in when no one could dine in. I don't eat pasta, but tried the sauce on the dish my husband got and it was very good. It was creamy and a great flavor. I think he had the MichaelAngelo with mushrooms and bacon. 
It was packed up very well and ready when he ran in. It came with bread and I know he enjoyed it. 
I did get 2 pieces of pistachio cake and it was very good. The color was perfect for spring. It was so pretty and it was the best cake I have had it in a long time. It was very light and fluffy and had the best flavor and just the right amount of icing. 
I can't wait to go and be able to sit outside on the patio on a nice day.

This is such a cute spot! Came here for a surprise birthday party and food was awesome especially the fried tomato and chicken sandwiches! I came here on a Saturday evening and there was a live band playing as well! Germantown garden is the outside of the vesper day club/pool. My friends and I talked to management and they're re-doing the inside so look out for that!

The atmosphere is really cool, they have live piano in the evenings, and the wine and whiskey lists are extensive. We really enjoyed the dishes we ordered, though they were a bit small for the price. The bottle prices on wine are really reasonable, though. The downstairs is an upscale vibe, perfect for a romantic evening!

Love this place with all my heart! It's my go to place and get take out from here at least once every two weeks. Everything tastes phenomenal. The deserts are great as well! My favorite is the  Tom Yom soup.
Food was mediocre at best. Nothing stood out that would want me to come back. Menu was short and pricey
Grilled chicken wrap and fries is pretty good. The view is always beautiful. Service is really good and the music is cool. Enjoyed it!
I just wish the wait was not so long to get in!  The dumplings are sublime here.  Service is quick and the atmosphere is energetic.  Chinatown parking is a nightmare but you just suck it up and go.

It is a rare and wonderful thing when you find a business you just seem to instantly love, and even better when that business becomes a regular part of your routine.

Coffee N' Comics recently passed their One Year Anniversary of being open here in Reno, and wow, where has the time gone?  In the span of those 365 days, this place has become, hands down, my most visited business in our region, and I am always thrilled and delighted whenever I walk through their doors.

As written about before, their menu covers all the bases you could want.  Coffee, tea, standard cafe favorites, and tons of house specialty drinks.  Beer and wine available, and plenty of food on the menu from light pastries to snack on, to burritos, sandwiches, and breakfast bowls.  All at pretty reasonable prices.

There are also plenty of events going on here, too.  Though keep in mind COVID restrictions  may still apply if crowds are big enough.  From hosting of game tournaments and art classes, to stand-up comedy nights, there seems to be activity here all throughout the day and evenings.

But what I think what really, truly, sets this place apart is the sense that the owners and staff want to build a place for the community, a place we can come in, relax, and unwind for a while.  And really, we all need that more these days.  The crew here are top-notch at service, and beyond that, seem to always have smiles on their faces, always working on some new project or other, and finding ever new and different way
Never been inside, because we did a lot of take out from John Lucas . All I can tell everyone is the food is very good and it always comes nice and hot and on time !!

This place is excellent!!! We got fried shrimp and Cajun fries... and 2 of the bags. Shrimp, sausage, and scallops with potatoes and corn... we got the Mr and Mrs crab seasoning... one mild and one medium. Both were excellent!! We can't wait to come back. I ordered the fried shrimp and it was great but the bags were way better so I can't wait to go back and order one.

Someone ended up bringing us a staff meal from Zaika. We all received a three pack container of butter chicken, rice, and a chickpea dish with garlic naan. Everything was unbelievable how good it was. I can't wait to dine in at this bistro. We were
GALETTE SOOOOOO GOOD ham, creamed spinach with guyere cheese, fried egg! So worth it!

The best bibimbap I've ever had.  It had fresh leafy vegetables and mushrooms which reduced the heavy taste of the traditional spicy sauce.  The 69 degree eggs was perfect to mix with rice.  We also ordered The OBON Raman and street noodles.  Both met our expectations. The sushis we had were very creative with good flavor and texture.  They had the right amount of crunchiness with the rice. I was only disappointed a little by their bun.  The flavor was right but the meat could be more tender.

Never going back...I ordered veggie tacos with cilantro, onion, lettuce, & tomato they charged me $1.50 for the lettuce and tomato (I did not even get cheese and sour cream)...Look at my pic to see what they think $1.50 worth of lettuce and tomato is...When I asked "sophia" the cashier for the manager she ignored my request. I returned my $1.50 pico de gallo because there was no way I was paying $1.50 TWICE for a little bit of chopped up lettuce and tomato. I also got a side of rice....No utensils or napkins were provided. Oh and there was no onion and cilantro on any of my tacos.

Had a great experience recently at Nektar! There were only 3 groups of people around us and everyone was generously spread out. This made the experience feel very safe! The food is OUT OF THIS WORLD! They use beautiful ingredients and make some unique dishes! Some of my favorites are the wings, the flatbreads and the octopus! Highly recommend!!

This is the best seafood I've had in Tucson and that says a lot considering lol the excellent places to eat here. I highly recommend the Manta Rey taco and the fish and shrimp ceviche. Everything tasted fresh and the portions are good too.

They say a picture is worth a thousand words, and, I mean... LOOK AT THAT BURRATA TOAST! Encircled by close to a dozen pieces of freshly grilled baguette, the balsamic glazed burrata is served a top a pile of juicy roma tomatotes and fresh basil. This appetizer, plus a bottle of one of their delicious white wines, and you are good to go. Not to mention the 5-star service we consistently receive when stopping in there. A perfect spot for locals & visitors alike.

Twin peaks is a wonderful place!  I always enjoy their food and craft beer selection.   Of course, the beautiful ladies are also a nice addition to the experience!    Allie was a wonderful bartender and kept me and my friends entertained with jokes and conversation.    The atmosphere at twin peaks is wonderful and inviting to the customer.   If I did not travel for work every other week, I would be at twin peaks on a regular basis.   Great restaurant with great food!
Great local spot! Very fair prices for Westhaven. Well executed and delicious gastro pub food. We will be back!
This place is amazing! We ordered the chicken tikka masala, garlic naan, and chicken biryani. All were SO delicious that we ordered two days in a row!! Highly recommend!

The jelly donut burger is amazing, the beer is phenomenal, the ambiance is very relaxing and extremely enjoyable for large parties with plenty to do to keep everyone entertained. The appetizers we tried were the nachos, the fried pickles and tater tots. All were very good! Thumbs up.

We have been to Culvers twice, have yet to try the Butter Burgers, because we like the Fish. Great onion rings. My kids and Grandkids came down for a visit a few weekends ago. Everybody ordered different foods and loved whatever they ordered. They couldn't get over how many onion rings are in the large order. I will be trying the Butter Burger the next time.

I don't get it. It's a fast food place run by kids in the middle of a Stepford Wives community! We were looking forward to it based on the reviews. The pizza was mediocre. The garlic knots were good but you can't make a meal out of that. The kids running the place were more interested in their phones than working. I saw one employee walk in front of a car while looking at her phone as she crossed the street to deliver a pizza. They need to watch that Easy Bake style pizza oven as close as they watch their cell phones! Will not go back.

Had drinks and dinner here a month ago and found it to be very warm and inviting. We sat outside which was nice and required and even though the covered patio is in the parking lot it didn't feel that way as the landscaping was efficient. It may sound strange but one can judge a lot by the state of the bathrooms and this restaurant didn't disappoint. The food was good although not great (4 of 5) but the service was great as our waitress was attentive, knowledgeable and pleasant. Would certainly recommend this establishment which is why I'm writing this review.

Best pizza in all of Bucks County! Even better than the place that used to be in Trenton that is now in Yardley. Much, much better. So much better. The crust is delicious with nothing on it. They don't use the high-gluten flour that everyone else uses. It is much lighter. You don't feel like you ate lead after you finish. The sauce and cheese have so much flavor. Perfect amount of salt and spices. We had the Sicilian. The eggplant melts in your mouth. I was in Italy last month, and this is as good, if not better than anything I had there. Really authentic. Worth every penny. It is pricey compared to most pizza joints, but if you figure in the cost of a plane ticket to Italy to find pizza that comes close to how good this is, it's a bargain. If you like Domino's and Pizza Hut, this is not for you.

I really did not want to sit at home with an entire box of donuts during quarantine. Well I did, but I didn't you know?....Anyway Dottie's made it way too easy for me to order them online and pick them up from their window the next morning. 

I am personally not vegan, but I do try to watch my meat consumption as I hear it could help with energy and acne so truth be told I didn't buy these because they were vegan. I bought them because they looked absolutely delicious and I am team Donut. While they were delicious, not exactly what I was expecting. They were much chewier and dense than I imagined. Don't let their delicate yeast donut appearance fool you. these are not donuts you can just keep popping in your mouth. I was full after a couple bites.

Head's up though, you MUST pre-order these 24 hours ahead of time on their website and you can't pick which flavors they give you. Sort of like an omakase experience here since I guess they don't want to have to put up with picky consumers. Don't be weird. Enjoy the flavors they give you and be thankful that you're fortunate enough to be buying donuts at a time like this.

I have.not been to a Philly's Finest in years, today I decided to stop in.  First impressions, clean, well lit and great tunes!  Ordered my lunch and sat down.  Enjoyed the music while waiting.  Lunch arrived and my expectations were exceeded after one bite. Great original cheese steak and slaw.  Additionally, they have RC cola on tap!  A personal favorite of mine since childhood.  All this time going to the other sandwich place near here, (they're good too), I feel like I have been missing out on this little treasure.  I will be back!

I order the food to-go so I wasn't able to eat the food at its best. But, even if it's carryout the quality can be a lot better. I was expecting cheaply made Italian food but what I got was a sad excuse of a meatball pasta and dry breadstick. I wouldn't recommend to carryout of this place. Maybe dining in is better but I do not want to try at all.

While visiting St Pete with family, we have always wanted to come and eat here at the Library, because it's been recommended. During these times, it's important to support these businesses that are doing their part to keep us safe while still providing the food and services we need.
The atmosphere- It's a really nice place and the staff is very attentive and friendly. We were a group of seven and looking for a restaurant offering indoor seating. 
They have a hand sanitizer station as soon as you walk in and there's plenty of spacing and social distancing offered. The staff is all wearing face masks. Our server, Heather H., was great at offering recommendations and options for menu items.

The food - It's not easy to find restaurants that have true plant based options on their menu or willing to make adjustments to menu items.  We called ahead and they took the time to tell us the items they offered that could be made into vegan options. I was excited that they had these plant based options. 
I ordered the vegan chili, mixed fruit and vegan bar. The others in the group ordered fish tacos, burgers with truffle fries, and espresso brownie for dessert. 
The prices are good and the food was delicious and plentiful.

We had a great experience here for dinner last night. The outdoor seating is quite nice with planters in between tables, lights and wooden deck. The service was great and the food was really good. I had the shrimp and grits and black eyed pea hummus. It's a byob which is also a plus. Definitely recommended

Have eaten here several times and always great food and service!  I love the pizza and salads. Pulled pork sandwich was very flavorful too!  I typically sit at the bar and bartenders are very attentive. Lots of choices for draft beer. Being right in the monon green space makes for a fun atmosphere. I will continue to frequent this place!

Spouse, Kid, and I decided to go on the way to the airport.  Spouse is really into racing, so he suggested coming here, in particular since it has a really neat race track course attached to it.  We didn't go to that (not enough time), but we did get dinner.  Kid had a burger, Spouse had....something...and I had a breaded chicken sandwich with onion rings with an adult beverage.

The adult beverage was delicious - it was vodka with strawberry puree of some variety.  The onion rings were also tasty, as were the Kid's sweet potato fries.  Unfortunately, my chicken sandwich wasn't great.  I think it's because it was butterflied, and therefore the meat dried out.  I asked the Spouse and he said it was pretty typical.  He liked it, but next time I'd go with the portobello cap sandwich instead.  But we'll definitely be back (I wanna place on the race track!), and I hope to update the rating accordingly.
This is my favorite place to visit when I come to NOLA!  The staff is super friendly and helpful and they have the best bloody Mary's!

The dinner was ok. Expectations vs Reality. There are such beautiful pictures of the food at Rusty Pelican on Yelp reviews. And the food looks nothing like those pictures. I have ordered Blackened Swordfish, and it looked like charcoal. Steak was fine. Overall the experience could be better.
The best place for a healthy treat! The smoothie bowls are great and the staff is so welcoming! Highly recommend!

First time visiting from out of town! We came on a boy trip from Arizona and can honestly say it was the best food we had the whole time! Our server Sierra was awesome! She was Very attentive, had great suggestions, and we genuinely had a blast. glad to have found a new local spot for when we swing through again! Also the BEST brunch deal in town can't say enough about this place!

I live in the neighborhood and frequent Box. The problem here is it's mega inconsistent. Sometimes breakfast and service is good other times miserable. Rarely should you expect prompt service... frequently waiting 20+ mins for your order. It seems every time I'm in there the same plate is served a different way.

We had the sampler but we were not that impressed with any of it. The best thing was the appetizer redfish beignets, those were the best like a funnel cake fish and chips batter. The service was amazing and so friendly and fast.

I've never been more disappointed with a franchise. The lady who took my order got it wrong 3 times and told me I need to repay since it's not what I ordered. I ordered a 3 piece tender and a chicken sandwich all spicy and never even got that until after her 3rd time trying again. She then screwed up my coworkers order who asked for mild and got spicy two times in a row. We finally got the manager who then is rude as hell acting like it's our fault. Anyway though while waiting on our food (which was bland btw) I watch that girl mess up 5 more orders (that I'm aware of and counted) to the point the place was getting packed trying to fix order. I don't recommend ever going back and if I could remember their names I'd let their higher ups know.

Tia P. was such an amazing server tonight. She went above and beyond when we had a small issue with our drink order and had the bar manager come to our table who quickly fixed the drinks free of charge! We will be back.

I love the idea of "everything vegan"... so dietary vegans don't have to ask or ponder. Service was disorganized including the meal preparation. The cashier explained he was new. I arrived on a Wednesday about 1:15pm and they were out of rolls...OK give me bread. Seitan laid out open just inches from the cashier and customers on the meat cutter... not a sanitary move. Mom bought plastic gloves and had to climb in to help the only meal preparer. This is in Reading Terminal market which I presume can get busy during lunchtime. Be prepared... have plenty of food and other supplies to deal with the lunch rush. I relish the concept but the execution falls short.
Chicken Bacon Ranch pizza is my favorite. The Tropical is the GF's favorite. Very good, and multiple other fun options.

Lowest possible rating!  Same food as every other McDonald's but their only job at the drive through was a complete failure. Food took ten minutes, two large orders of fries were cold to the touch after driving .3 miles to my hotel. Literally one block! Double cheeseburgers (2) were actually cold bun/unmelted cheese not even microwaved cold. McNuggets were obviously reheated and beyond tough.  Apparently they cook up a few of every most served item and just let them sit until some poor fool orders one and then they just nuke em.  Except these jerks can't even do that!   $25.31 of cold inedible food from this store. Do yourself a favor and go to the gas station next door for better food than here!   DO NOT PATRONIZE!

Best smoked fish dip in the area, trust me I've had almost all of them. The place is overall is relaxed and fun but they only offer 1 size for spread if you're eating there...sooooooo it's best to get a pint to go if you have a few people to feed. 

ALSO ITS CASH ONLY!

Came here a few weeks ago for a bachelorette brunch with a group of 5 other girls. The restaurant is upstairs from the bakery and the decor is very pretty! We made a reservation for a Sunday morning brunch and were seated right on time. The food was fantastic, a perfect blend of southern charm and breakfast food. I opted to get something lighter and fresh and the caprese sandwich hit the spot. Also picked up a strawberry macaroon on the way out for desert which was delicious!
Love this place!  We go here for take out, dine in, and happy hour.  Friendly staff and amazing food. Take out during COVID has been life saver.
